title: PH series 'Never the Bride' presented at TorinoFilmLab in Italy

blocks.text: “Never the Bride,” a Filipino drama series from Ice Seguerra and Liza Diño’s Fire & Ice Media, was presented at the TorinoFilmLab in Turin, Italy, under its SeriesLab program. According to the entertainment company, the series is the first Southeast Asian-led series project to participate in the program’s 10-year history. It is also the only Asian-led series in this year’s nine selections, which were chosen from 96 applications across 50 countries.
